title: Jazzy Jamaican Chicken Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and double-fry KFC style chicken, served in a dolsot stone bowl.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the gluten-free flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Toss the chicken pieces in the flour mixture to coat, shaking off excess.

Double-fry the chicken by frying it in the hot oil for 5 minutes, then removing it and letting it cool for 5 minutes, and finally frying it again for an additional 5 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat the Jamaican jerk seasoning over medium heat for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes to the pan with the jerk seasoning and stir to combine.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the double-fry chicken in the bottom of a dolsot stone bowl, followed by a spoonful of the sun-dried tomato and jerk seasoning mixture.
Serve the Jazzy Jamaican Chicken Bowl hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
